To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
novel spirocycled pyrrolidin-2-ones can be synthesized in two steps, and that this method has been applied in the synthesis of the central diamine of Sitafloxacin.

we developed a new method for the synthesis of spirocyclic azetidines, pyrrolidinones, and pyrrolidinium salts from common three- and five-membered-ring ketones, and that the developed method has been applied to the synthesis of the central diamine cores of Sitafloxacin (an antibacterial) and Olamufloxacine (an antibacterial).

the synthesis of spirocyclic azacycles has been achieved from common three- and four-membered-ring (het-ero)alicycyclic ketones via a novel reaction between electron-deficient exo-cyclic alkenes and in situ generated N-alkyl azomethines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel synthetic methods for the construction of spirocyclic structures and their application for the synthesis of advanced drug discovery building blocks.
the development of new and improved methodologies to synthesize spirocyclic heterocyclic compounds.
the synthesis and biological evaluation of new compounds that can act as inhibitors of protein tyrosine phosphatases (PTPs).

spirocyclic compounds have a broad spectrum of biological activities.
the presented synthetic method is an efficient tool for the synthesis of spirocyclic 2-pyrrolidones from a broad range of readily available starting materials.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an efficient, one-step method for the synthesis of a broad range of spirocyclic N-benzyl pyrrolidin-2-ones, which is applicable for the synthesis of the central diamine cores of the antibacterial agents Sitafi- and Olamufloxacins.
we have established a general method for the synthesis of spirocyclic 1,3-diamine derivatives from a wide variety of cyclic ketones.
we have developed a method to synthesize novel spirocylclic pyrrolidones from common three- and four-membered ring (hetero)-alicyclic aldehydes and ketones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed methodology is a general method that allows for the synthesis of spirocyclic heterocycles in a single operation and with excellent yields.
spirocyclic compounds can be accessed in a straightforward manner and are therefore excellent starting materials for further synthetic elaboration.
